decision.explanation: The provided evidence (pmid-26829751:f01) confirms that MYB::QKI fusions are specific to Angiocentric Glioma, identifying the fusion in 6 of 7 profiled cases. However, the text does not contain data regarding the variant origin (somatic vs germline) or the specific age of onset (childhood/juvenile) for the patients in this cohort. Therefore, the evidence is insufficient to support the claim as written.

citations.quote: In total, all 19 Angiocentric Gliomas profiled by WGS, RNA-seq, WES, FISH, or aCGH displayed MYB alterations, and in six of the seven cases in which its fusion partner could be detected, MYB was fused to QKI. . . .
